title: Granola brings one-tap AI meeting notes to Apple Watch
friendlyTitle: Granola can now take meeting notes from Apple Watch
summary: Granola has launched a free Apple Watch companion for starting meeting notes with a tap during walking meetings, whiteboard sessions and other conversations away from a laptop. Notes sync to its iPhone and desktop apps and can become context for connected AI tools through Granola MCP.
friendlySummary: You can tap your Apple Watch to start a Granola note, then read and edit it later on your phone or computer.
whyItMatters: Wearable capture can reduce the temptation to keep a laptop open during every conversation, while preserving follow-ups for later review. Users should make recording clear to everyone present and apply appropriate consent and data-handling rules.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may help you stay focused on the person instead of a laptop. Always tell people when a conversation is being recorded.
